remaining_facets.scope: Stored, literal-only fixed, verified first native-dynamic and distinct concatenated-member encodings of complete real bytes are timed and reconstruct exactly the original. Exact fixed distance1/distance32768, adversarial malformed layouts and CRC/truncation boundaries remain package/contract correctness; no periodic payload is generated.

Distinct equal files and genuinely different complete modules are timed. Synthetic sparse/distributed edits are not natural workload evidence; future real revision pairs need their own registered source identities.
Natural airport/routes shared and unpaired keys are timed. Two-sided duplicate Cartesian expansion has no declared real-source timing witness and remains a finite correctness/next-corpus gap.

The real JSON registry activates selection, missing-property nulls, per-document slurp, numeric aggregation, sorting and grouping. Several independent top-level real documents and exceptionally large JSON objects are not implied.

Natural text/tree count, spans, output, misses, pipe, slow sink, empty and genuine87443-byte records are timed. Historical64MiB single records, DFA cache/budget/phase pressure and engine-route claims remain private correctness or separately observed limitations.

Loopback transfer uses genuine source bytes and declared GET/POST/PUT operations. Auth/cookies, replay, framing, redirects, retries, resume, timeout and output cleanup remain exact local scenario boundaries; numerical delay and public-network performance are not claimed.

The bounded complete-file collection does not establish permission denial, arbitrary links, full metadata or cross-platform traversal parity. Required local cases cover only their exact stated platform facets.

Local cases must execute through the current frozen Wasm/contract driver before timing. Declared case IDs, corpus feature labels, timing success or profile counts alone are not correctness passes. Missing/skipped unsupported required applicable witnesses, observation mismatches, incomplete windows and unstable timing are not accepted.

mode_contract_scope: Declared-operation contracts reviewed before candidate execution: exact allowed argv, preparation recipe and expected status per command/mode, independent of workload row IDs. Operation facets describe the requested operation and require actual input/transport observations plus native calibration and independent local correctness; argv does not prove data-feature activation, matcher route, internal fast path, temporary I/O or bytes read. Sorting for join/comm is untimed genuine-source preparation; spill is a requested sort run budget only. These finite definitions do not establish execution or performance acceptance.
